thread.title: There are too many emoji and it's time for Apple to take a stand (AAPL)

author: Avery Hartmans
title: There are too many emoji and it's time for Apple to take a stand (AAPL)

The lives of texting Texans got a lot easier Monday night when the long-awaited TexMoji app, stocked with hundreds of tiny Lone Star-centric emoticons, was released in the Apple App Store.
